 Print The trailer of Dhanush ’s upcoming movie ‘OM – Chapter 1: Udhiram – The Blood Wood’ has created a lot of buzz in the movies world. It will be a thrilling ride with its mix of crime, action, and drama elements. Ahead of November 20 release, the trailer is notable for its visual effects, intense background music, and performances of lead actors. Fans have been quite active online to express their feelings about the trailer, especially the scale of the movie and the actor’s new look. Fans praise Sai Pallavi 's character and Rajkumar Periasamy 's direction
 Talking about the trailer, Sai Pallavi's character has been one of the most appreciated elements. A fan loved her performance and praised the director for giving her a powerful role. He commented, “Sai Pallavi casually dominating the star performer and a legendary actor. Kudos to Rajkumar Periasamy for convincing stars and giving/sticking to a female-centric character like this.” Another viewer praised the overall presentation, saying, “The expressions and attitude are simply outstanding. #OMTrailer has created huge excitement.” These reactions suggest that the actress's character could be one of the major attractions of the film. Sai Abyankkar's background score gets mixed reactions

 The combination of Dhanush and Mammootty has also generated considerable curiosity among fans. One enthusiastic viewer wrote, “Dhanush and Mammukka combination is giving us plenty of reasons to be excited. OM trailer looks like a blast.” Another fan praised the technical presentation, stating, “The cuts and background score work beautifully together. #OMTrailer is genuinely engaging.” However, the music and sound mixing received some criticism. A viewer pointed out, “Couldn't hear the dialogues clearly due to heavy BGM. Music is only to elevate the scenes and dialogues, not to overtake them. Sound mixing should have been much better.” Despite this concern, the trailer's overall impact appears to have impressed several moviegoers. Blood-soaked red sandalwood action and Dhanush's transformation raise expectations
 The red sandalwood forest setting and action sequences have further increased anticipation for the film. One fan described the experience as “Pure goosebumps! "See the bloody fight in the forest of red sandalwood." A second audience member gave a more elaborate explanation of the plot, stating that Dhanush might play a special task force agent working within a sandalwood smugglers' group controlled by Mammootty, where Sai Pallavi plays the role of an IPS officer. Though the actual plot is yet to be confirmed, the trailer has definitely raised questions.
